runners.comment: Up 4lb for his Kempton fall but he was threatening when coming down
runners.name: Old Cowboy
runners.spotlight: Won readily by 4l under a positive ride over C&D over Christmas (good) and, having sat off a strong pace, he was threatening when coming down two out at Kempton (2m4f, good; bled from the nose); annoyingly raised 4lb for that mishap and his improvement has come on drier ground, though was placed in a soft-ground novice hurdle at this track.

runners.comment: Bumper and 2m4f maiden hurdle winner; has a long absence to overcome on his chasing debut
runners.name: Leading Choice
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 2m4f maiden hurdle winner; very lightly raced 9yo who seems to enjoy the mud but has a long absence to overcome on his chasing debut and he's the lowest rated of these by some margin.

runners.comment: Flashes of good form over fences; poor last time but now goes in new blinkers
runners.name: Personal Ambition
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner; 0-6 over fences but highly tried on occasions and unlucky not to win a Grade 2 at Ascot last season; disappointed in that same race two months ago but new headgear could help him turn things around.

runners.comment: Big run last time; surprising to see him back at 2m but the ground will be testing
runners.name: Quebecois
runners.spotlight: Tongue-tie has been retained since he won a 3m handicap hurdle at last season's big April meeting at Ayr; runner-up in two of his three chases and jumped well when nosed out by the likeable Jordans Cross at Cheltenham last month (2m4f, soft); surprising to see him back at 2m but at least the ground will be testing, and he'd be giving weight to all his rivals in a handicap.

14:45.race_name: Boyle Sports Cheltenham Bank Builder Jackpot Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Placed in points but has shown precious little in two runs over hurdles; this is no easier
runners.name: Back On Track
runners.spotlight: Placed in points but has shown precious little in two runs over hurdles; this is no easier.

runners.comment: No match for an easy winner at Southwell; highly likely that he'll need more here
runners.name: Fouroneohfever
runners.spotlight: Four wins for George Boughey at 1m2f/1m4f and useful in that scene (effective on soft); wouldn't have won when falling at Sandown and then no match for a dark horse at Southwell; highly likely that he'll need more here.

runners.comment: Smart Flat form in 2024; beaten about 11l into third last time at Wincanton
runners.name: Galashiels
runners.spotlight: Very smart Flat form in 2024, including on soft ground; not as good now judged on his exploits for current yard, though ran encouragingly to be an 11l third (led 3f out) at Wincanton behind Saturday's Victor Ludorum runner-up Pourquoi Pas Papa; now has to build on that.

runners.comment: Beaten favourite in his two maiden hurdles but won a bumper and can do better
runners.name: Giantsgrave
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground bumper winner; a beaten favourite in his two maiden hurdles, at 2-5 first time and at 11-10 when let down by his jumping at Ffos Las (beaten 26l over 2m4f); should be capable of better.

runners.comment: It was probably a modest Irish point (3m, yielding) in which he dead-heated in November
runners.name: Global Fortune
runners.spotlight: It was probably a modest Irish point (3m, yielding) in which he dead-heated in November and best watched on rules debut.

runners.comment: Bangor winner before finishing down the field at 200-1 in the Champion Bumper
runners.name: Lancelot Allen
runners.spotlight: Beat a subsequent winning hurdler in a soft-ground bumper at Bangor before finishing down the field at 200-1 in the Champion Bumper; he's not the easiest to weigh up and has been off for nearly a year.

runners.comment: A close third over hurdles in France (heavy) back in late 2024; bought for £85,000
runners.name: Lets Love
runners.spotlight: Bought for £85,000 after finishing a close third over hurdles in France (2m1f, heavy) back in late 2024; stable had welcome winners over the weekend but a watching brief seems best.

runners.comment: Had two runs over hurdles, beaten 14l at Hereford (good) and 21l at Huntingdon (soft)
runners.name: Lully Du Houx
runners.spotlight: Had two runs over hurdles, beaten 14l at Hereford (good) and 21l at Huntingdon (soft); looks one for further down the line.

runners.comment: Point/bumper form respected; quiet debut over hurdles and the hood is removed
runners.name: Mulinas
runners.spotlight: Bought for £170,000 after beating the high-class Potters Charm in an Irish point; ran okay in two small-field bumpers in early 2024 (heavy/soft) and Paul Nicholls retained him for £50,000 at the dispersal sale of his previous owner; made a disappointing comeback on his hurdling debut when hooded (now removed) at Doncaster (2m3f, soft; 14-1); bit to prove after that.

runners.comment: Quite promising in bumpers; tailed off in two maiden hurdles but has had a wind operation
runners.name: My Boy Aaron
runners.spotlight: Quite promising in bumpers; tailed off in two maiden hurdles but has had a wind operation, which did the trick for the stable's smart Caballero Cliff at Wincanton on Saturday; not that this 6yo is in his league.

runners.breeder: S A S Haras Le Gue
runners.comment: Placed on the Flat without winning; should have the stamina for hurdling
runners.name: Seeking Charles
runners.spotlight: Placed on the Flat without winning; should have the stamina for hurdling but unlikely to be good enough here.

runners.comment: Heavy-ground Flat winner in France and it's been a bright start over hurdles
runners.name: Talakan
runners.spotlight: Bought for 40,000euros after winning over 1m6f in France (heavy) when in the Aga Khan colours; it's been a bright start over hurdles, following a third at Ascot with a near miss at Ludlow (soft); every chance.

15:20.race_name: Boyle Sports Home Of Early Payout 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Building a likeable profile and he's still entered in the Turners at Cheltenham
runners.name: Bobbys Nelson
runners.spotlight: Beaten by good horses in his first two runs over hurdles before getting off the mark at Ffos Las (2m4f, soft), the form of which was franked by third winning easily last week; smacks of a strong stayer and he's still entered in the Turners at Cheltenham.

runners.comment: Made all over this trip at Leicester; 3m looked too far in a good novice at Windsor
runners.name: Swindon Village
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; made all at Leicester (2m4f, soft) and didn't appear to get home over 3m in a useful novice at Windsor; again has the penalty but this looks more suitable; holds the 2m5f/3m novice entries at Cheltenham.

runners.comment: Recruited for £95,000 after narrowly winning a Quakerstown point; in at Cheltenham
runners.name: Boultydoolin
runners.spotlight: Recruited for £95,000 after narrowly winning a Quakerstown point (3m, yielding to soft) and the runner-up has since won in that scene; Rebecca Curtis has him in the Albert Bartlett at Cheltenham; couldn't rule out.

runners.comment: Sold for £55,000 soon after finishing third in a 12-runner Irish point in early December
runners.name: Dantes Rocco
runners.spotlight: Sold for £55,000 soon after finishing third in a 12-runner Irish point in early December; faces no easy starter under rules.

runners.comment: Runner-up in two points but no positives to take from his two runs over hurdles
runners.name: Mymilkman
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two points but no positives to take from his two runs over hurdles.

runners.comment: Bought for £1,200 after pulling up in an Irish point a year ago
runners.name: Stavanger Rose
runners.spotlight: Bought for £1,200 after pulling up in an Irish point a year ago; tongue-tie fitted.

15:55.race_name: 500 Logistics Decade Of Delivery Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Mme Henri Devin & Mme Victoria Devin
runners.comment: Belated return to fences and recent hurdling exploits leave him with much to prove
runners.name: Saint Palais
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his old chase form but this is a belated return to fences and recent hurdling exploits leave him with much to prove.

runners.comment: Hard to predict but steadied his ship when second in a small field at Taunton
runners.name: Brave Kingdom
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 10yo who can be hard to predict but steadied his ship when second in a small field at Taunton (2m7f, heavy; second run after a wind operation); has to back that up but he's capable of winning off this sort of mark.

runners.comment: All good since the cheekpieces went on, winning three times; now returns to further
runners.name: Good Friday Fairy
runners.spotlight: All good since the cheekpieces went on, winning three times (2m3f-2m5f, good to soft/soft); kept on well for third off today's mark at Exeter (2m3f, good to soft) last month and returning to further looks the right move.

runners.breeder: Mrs P Souverain & Mr A De Boisbrunet
runners.comment: 3-13 over fences, the last win in December off 4lb lower; unseated midrace last time
runners.name: Happy And Fine
runners.owner: L Cross S Cross & J Fitzpatrick
runners.spotlight: Back to form when winning for a third time over fences in a 3m handicap at Warwick (good to soft) and would have won easier had he not idled late on; unseated midrace off this 4lb higher mark at Leicester three weeks later; respected.

runners.comment: Won comfortably over further (on soft) at Wincanton when in the new cheekpieces
runners.name: Major Fortune
runners.spotlight: Prolific winner over hurdles; it was in a lower grade when getting off the mark over fences at Wincanton (3m1f, soft) but that was fairly comfortable and it was his first time in cheekpieces; off 5lb higher he can make his presence felt.

runners.breeder: Mme M Hanquiez Mr G Hanquiez & Earl L
runners.comment: Failed to fire at Windsor a month ago but this mark isn't beyond him if back on song
runners.name: Jupiter Des Bordes
runners.spotlight: Won at Warwick in December (3m, soft) and then close up in a small field over 3m4f at Haydock (good to soft); failed to fire over that far at Windsor a month ago but this mark isn't beyond him if back on song.

runners.comment: Has course form and was second over 3m4f at Windsor on return from an absence
runners.name: Havaila
runners.spotlight: Last season's solid run of form included a second over C&D; made an excellent return to action when only 2l off the winner over 3m4f at Windsor last month; up 2lb but firmly in the mix.

runners.comment: Second to an unexposed winner over C&D latest; can give another good account
runners.name: Sheldon
runners.spotlight: Not overly consistent and can make mistakes; however, ran well for a very long way on testing ground at Exeter before no match for an unexposed winner over C&D; could give another good account of himself.

runners.comment: Only a 7yo and it's been a fairly solid start over fences, from 2m4f to 3m1f
runners.name: As The Fella Says
runners.spotlight: A little below his best when a 14l fourth at Windsor (2m6f, soft) but still ran fine and commands considerable respect on his previous runs, over 2m4f at Southwell (soft) and 3m1f at Cheltenham (good to soft); only a 7yo and still early days over fences.

16:30.race_name: Finli Live Your Best Financial Life Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Wincanton was disappointing but remains on a fair mark if he can shrug aside that run
runners.name: One Eye On Vegas
runners.spotlight: Won a Leicester handicap (2m4f, soft) for the second season running in early December, edging out Cast's Tasha; Wincanton was disappointing but remains on a fair mark if he can shrug aside that run.

runners.comment: Appreciated return to hurdles when third in a big field here over; 2m4f perhaps better
runners.name: De Kingpin
runners.spotlight: Failed to take to fences but got back on track returned to hurdles in reapplied cheekpieces when third of 17 here last month (3m, good to soft); this could be his trip, over which he won a novice here.

runners.comment: Hat-trick bid came up short but he can jump better than he did at Aintree
runners.name: Glance Of Glory
runners.spotlight: Two wins over 2m4f on good ground at Worcester (maiden/handicap) and, although only fourth on soft off this higher mark at Aintree, he didn't run badly given his jumping lacked fluency; still lightly raced and by no means ruled out.

runners.comment: Hasn't looked on a good mark in his two handicaps and that could still be the case
runners.name: Close Combat
runners.spotlight: Exeter novice winner (2m, heavy); hasn't looked on a good mark in his two handicaps and that could still be the case, though Murray Dodd claiming 7lb will help in that respect.

runners.comment: Has the form to feature but hard to be confident after her last two efforts
runners.name: Casts Tasha
runners.owner: Sue & Clive Cole & Ann & Tony Gale
runners.spotlight: Has performed moderately the last twice but her near miss behind One Eye On Vegas at Leicester in December (2m4f, soft) brings her into this; hard to be confident about her chances, though.

runners.comment: Following a break he was beaten about 10l in 1m7f/2m3f handicaps on his last two starts
runners.name: Balboa
runners.spotlight: Beaten in the region of 10l in 1m7f/2m3f handicaps the last twice after a break of 183 days; dropping in the weights but others are much preferred.

runners.comment: Career best at Exeter; respected off 7lb higher with heavy ground no issue for him
runners.name: Robbers Bridge
runners.spotlight: His 24th race over hurdles at Exeter last month (2m5f, good to soft) but produced career-best form in winning that handicap by some 11l; respected off 7lb higher with heavy ground no issue for him.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Lonray
runners.comment: Lingfield winner but found nothing for pressure when then beaten 7l at Plumpton
runners.name: Luwdvig
runners.owner: The Ridgeway Racing For Fun Partnership
runners.spotlight: Looked good in winning at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) but found nothing for pressure when beaten 7l off this 8lb higher mark at Plumpton; that was disappointing.

runners.comment: Ran surprisingly well in a novice here last time and raised in trip for handicap debut
runners.name: Painted Wolf
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner in 2023; ran surprisingly well at odds of 300-1 when beaten about 14l by a well-touted novice over 2m here a month ago; probably flattered as they went no pace but could still be interesting on handicap debut now sent further.

runners.comment: Has basically become a bit disappointing and he's not shaping like a winner in waiting
runners.name: Teorie
runners.spotlight: Continues to slip down the weights but has basically become a bit disappointing and he's not shaping like a winner in waiting.

runners.comment: Ex-French gelding; nothing as yet for current yard but he's back on softer ground here
runners.name: Gustapof
runners.spotlight: Did well in France, winning over hurdles and competitive as a chaser; has yet to get anything going over hurdles for current yard (hooded last twice) but on good or good to soft and getting back on the mud could make a difference.

runners.comment: Down the field in two h'caps for Dan Skelton; market watch needed with Harry taking over
runners.name: Tyson
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who has finished down the field in two handicaps for Dan Skelton, over 2m4f (soft; 66-1) and 2m (good to soft; 50-1); Harry Skelton now takes over for the first time and may run better should he attract any support.

17:05.race_name: Boyle Sports Daily Money Back Meetings Conditional Jockeys' Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Has the form to feature off this mark but current wellbeing an issue back from a break
runners.name: Springs A Girl
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on peak hurdle form and her second on chase debut in September; pulled up next time and didn't offer much back over hurdles at Kempton, and that was three months ago.

runners.comment: Second on handicap debut at Lingfield (2m7f, soft) and may well have more to offer
runners.name: Harmony Heights
runners.owner: M Songer C Bailey & M Dodd
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced mare who was second on handicap debut at Lingfield (2m7f, soft) and may well have more to offer, especially with headgear turned to; respected.

runners.breeder: Ecurie Biraben D Biraben & A Biraben
runners.comment: Returns to hurdling off a useful mark and she's won twice in this discipline
runners.name: Kosasiempre
runners.spotlight: Has been chasing and won around Hereford in November (3m1f, good; won on soft), despite jumping out to her left; repeated the dose when only fourth there last month; returns to hurdling off a useful mark (without taking into account Murray Dodd's claim) and she's won twice in this discipline.

runners.comment: Good run in her final novice and longer trip should assist now in her first handicap
runners.name: Katies Melody
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner; has finished closer in each of her runs over hurdles, last time beaten about 8l at Wincanton (2m5f, heavy) behind two novices with potential; she too falls into that category now raised to 3m for her first handicap.

runners.comment: Perhaps flattered in her latest novice but she's up in trip for this handicap debut
runners.name: Star Of Honour
runners.spotlight: Dual point winner; an improved second in a Hereford novice (2m5f, soft) but off a slow pace was probably flattered to finish 2l behind the long odds-on favourite; still deserves some attention now sent further for her handicap debut.

13:30.race_name: Join Racing TV Now Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Eighth on stable/hurdles debut at Musselburgh last month and big improvement required.
runners.name: Flagstone
runners.spotlight: Always behind on sole Flat start, over 7f for John Joseph Murphy at Galway in July; beaten 26l when eighth of nine finishers on stable/hurdles debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft; 50-1) last month; first-time tongue-tie goes on and big improvement is required.

runners.comment: Fourth at Wetherby on second hurdles start last month and holds place claims.
runners.name: Knighton
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard and jumped to the right when tailed off on hurdle debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in December; showed a bit more in a first-time hood (retained) on softer ground when fourth of nine finishers at Wetherby (2m, soft; 200-1) last month and holds place claims.

runners.comment: Jumps debut, modest on Flat; probably best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.
runners.name: Law Degree
runners.spotlight: Modest handicapper these days on the Flat but dual winner on turf at around 1m in 2024; has stamina to prove on jumps debut and usual cheekpieces are left off; probably best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.

runners.comment: Dual winner on the Flat at 7f/1m; makes hurdle debut and is one to keep an eye on.
runners.name: Louie The Legend
runners.spotlight: Dual winner on the Flat at 7f/1m (fair form); beaten a neck on heavy at Nottingham in October; one to keep an eye on for hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Faded when 13l fifth in juvenile at Ascot last month; this is easier; leading stable
runners.name: Macshadow Des Crai
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in two French bumpers; similar form in three runs over hurdles, fading when 13l fifth of eight finishers in juvenile at Ascot (1m7f, soft; 11-2) last month; this race is easier and he should go close for leading stable.

runners.comment: Placed in both hurdles starts, latest when third at Wetherby last month.
runners.name: My Kinda Ghaiy
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden on the Flat for Hugo Palmer; has shown promise when placed in both hurdles starts, latest when third of nine finishers at Wetherby (2m, soft) last month; looks sure to make his presence felt.

runners.comment: Placed in his two hurdle starts, latest when runner-up at Chepstow three weeks ago.
runners.name: Senator
runners.spotlight: Placed in two starts on the Flat in France; has shaped encouragingly to be placed in his two hurdle starts, latest when runner-up at Chepstow (2m, soft) three weeks ago; looks sure to go close at the least.

runners.comment: Beaten 34l when sixth of seven on hurdle debut at Warwick last month.
runners.name: Lets Go Mo
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in a couple of bumpers; beaten 34l when sixth of seven on hurdle debut at Warwick (2m, good to soft; 150-1) last month; needs to step up considerably.

14:00.race_name: Watch On Racing TV EBF Mares' 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (EBF Mares' Hurdle Series Qual') (GBB)

runners.comment: Got off the mark at the third attempt over hurdles at Chepstow three weeks ago.
runners.name: Charisma Cat
runners.spotlight: 3-5 in bumpers last season, including a win at Listed level; she got off the mark at the third attempt over hurdles at Chepstow (2m, soft) three weeks ago; first-time cheekpieces go on and she still needs to brush up her jumping in order to progress but should run well.

runners.comment: Got off the mark over hurdles at Windsor last month on her first time on soft ground.
runners.name: Getawhisky
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who showed significant improvement when getting off the mark over hurdles at Windsor (2m) last month on her first time on soft ground; there should be more to come now that she has got her head in front.

runners.breeder: Elevage Du Colombier Haras De Saint-Voi
runners.comment: Beaten a short head by Watamu at Huntingdon in December but is 7lb better off.
runners.name: Khrisma
runners.spotlight: Won two Grade 3 bumpers over 1m4f on soft in France and showed useful form when placed in 2m novice events last year; got off the mark over hurdles with a minimum of fuss at Uttoxeter (2m, soft) in November and beaten a short head by Watamu at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) the following month; now 7lb better off with that rival; claims.

runners.comment: Won on hurdle debut at Worcester in October but yet to run on soft ground.
runners.name: No Tricks At All
runners.owner: M V Magnier Mrs P Shanahan & Dash Grange Stud
runners.spotlight: Fourth on bumper debut in the spring but improved to cause 18-1 surprise on hurdle debut at Worcester (2m, good) in October, form that has been boosted by the runner-up; this race is tougher and she has yet to encounter soft ground.

runners.comment: Beat Khrisma (who is now 7lb better off) by a short head at Huntingdon in December.
runners.name: Watamu
runners.spotlight: Landed a junior bumper on debut at Stratford for Pat Murphy in October 2024; shaped nicely in her first two starts over hurdles before coming good to beat Khrisma (who is now 7lb better off) by a short head at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) in December; needs to progress again.

runners.comment: Made a most encouraging hurdles debut when third of 14 finishers at Warwick last month.
runners.name: Edith Pelham
runners.spotlight: Maiden point winner and made a winning debut under rules in a bumper at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) in October; made a most encouraging hurdles debut when third of 14 finishers at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) last month; promising sort but may not be suited by the step back in trip.

runners.comment: Well held in two runs in bumpers and a couple over hurdles; needs more time.
runners.name: Midnight Bella
runners.owner: G R Orchard And C Clarke
runners.spotlight: Well held in two runs in bumpers and a couple over hurdles; needs more time.

runners.comment: Well beaten in both hurdles starts and this looks a tough assignment.
runners.name: Redeeming Love
runners.owner: R & W The 8 Amigos Burns Austerfield
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in both hurdles starts and this looks a tough assignment.

runners.comment: Decent bumper horse but yet to replicate that form in two runs over hurdles.
runners.name: Shotgun Shirley
runners.spotlight: Landed a bumper at Uttoxeter in October (2m, good) and second in a Listed contest at Cheltenham the following month; yet to replicate that form in two runs over hurdles but should do so in due course.

runners.comment: She has run two solid races over hurdles, latest when second at Chepstow three weeks ago.
runners.name: Trinity Street
runners.spotlight: Point winner and bumper runner-up, she has run two solid races over hurdles to be placed, latest when second to Charisma Cat at Chepstow (2m, soft) three weeks ago and now 7lb better off.

14:30.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Back over fences after a couple of failed attempts in November 2023.
runners.name: Bobalot
runners.spotlight: Has won three times over hurdles and finished third for the fourth successive time in that sphere at Southwell (3m, good to soft) 15 days ago; back over fences after a couple of failed attempts in November 2023 but tends to find at least one too good.

runners.comment: Makes belated chase debut after being well held over hurdles three weeks ago.
runners.name: Quickasican
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 9yo who was beaten 53l on first run for 21 months over hurdles at Newcastle (2m4f, heavy) three weeks ago; makes belated chase debut in first-time tongue-tie and cheekpieces; steps up in trip and hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Yet to get his head in front but just denied late on when runner-up over C&D in December.
runners.name: Alltalknoaction
runners.spotlight: Yet to get his head in front but only overhauled late on when runner-up over C&D (good to soft) in December in first-time cheekpieces (retained); looks sure to go close.

runners.comment: Placed for the third time this term when third at Sedgefield last month.
runners.name: Scottish King
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort since switching to fences this term, latest when placed for the third time when third of nine finishers at Sedgefield (3m2f, good to soft) last month in first-time cheekpieces (removed here); should run his race but finding it difficult to get his head in front.

runners.comment: Has found her mark over fences, winning twice around here over 2m3f.
runners.name: Florita
runners.spotlight: A dual runner-up in points, she cut little ice over hurdles but has found her mark over fences, winning twice around here over 2m3f; promises to stay 3m and holds solid claims.

runners.comment: Pulled up in her first two chases; showed more when second over C&D 16 days ago.
runners.name: Worth The Walk
runners.spotlight: Won heavy-ground Irish point in February 2024 but pulled up in her first two chases; showed much more when second to easy winner over C&D (soft) 16 days ago; a repeat of that effort gives her a chance.

15:02.race_name: Visit racingtv.com Mares' Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Mares' Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Ex-Irish pointer; progressive hurdles form and now tries 2m4f for the first time; chance
runners.name: Railway Bell
runners.spotlight: Placed in her two Irish points (3m, soft); has won a bumper, a novice hurdle and last time a handicap hurdle at 2m/2m1f on good/good to soft under rules, her only hurdles defeat when fourth on soft ground at Wincanton when returning from a 410-day break; should be suited by the step up to 2m4f; contender.

runners.comment: Has won seven races, but has been below par since winning claiming hurdle in November
runners.name: Mermaids Cave
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner at up to 2m4f; has been well below her best since winning a Huntingdon claiming hurdle in November (2m, good), last time with a visor tried (no chance when fell last); cheekpieces back on here, but others stronger.

runners.comment: Progressive form since wind op with two handicap wins over 2m4f this term; each-way chance
runners.name: Just Her Type
runners.spotlight: Has progressed well since having wind surgery in September, winning 2m4f handicaps at Ffos Las (soft) and Southwell (good to soft); creditable second to an odds-on shot in a novice at Ayr last time; each-way chance.

runners.comment: Three good runs over hurdles last term; conditions suit; interesting following wind op
runners.name: Presenting Doy
runners.spotlight: Won a Lingfield mares' maiden hurdle in February (2m3f, heavy) and good second in a mares' event on handicap debut at Uttoxeter the following month; reportedly made a respiratory noise when pulled up on reappearance; has since had wind surgery and much better expected.

runners.comment: Two wins at 2m7f/3m following wind surgery this term; career-high mark and down in trip
runners.name: Snowrocco
runners.spotlight: Has improved following wind surgery this season, winning handicaps at Newcastle (2m7f, good to soft) and Musselburgh (3m, good to soft); went up 9lb for latest win, so facing stiff task here, particularly as she is down in trip.

runners.comment: Exposed mare; not been at her best this season but on a good mark now; conditions fine
runners.name: Pretending
runners.spotlight: Exposed mare who hasn't been quite at her best this season, but is on a good mark (3lb lower than for last win); has an each-way chance.

runners.breeder: A Hales Mr & Mrs J Fry Mr D Fitzgerald
runners.comment: Ludlow winner off this mark last term; fair form this season including when 2nd last time
runners.name: Looking As You Are

runners.name: Sceptic
runners.spotlight: Last two wins have come over 9.5f/7f here, the latest in September; this trip should suit better than the 1m3f he tackled at Kempton 13 days ago; each-way claims.

runners.comment: 2-33 and recent efforts leave plenty to be desired, but has dropped to a favourable mark
runners.name: Kaaranah
runners.spotlight: Just 2-33 and recent efforts leave plenty to be desired; has dropped to a favourable mark, though, and the market may be the best indication of whether a resurgence is imminent.

20:00.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Rider Restricted Race) (Div I)

runners.breeder: Highpark B/Stock Ltd & Akuna B/Stock Ltd
runners.comment: Arrives in good form but her stamina has to be taken on trust
runners.name: Imola
runners.spotlight: Easy win at Southwell (1m; well backed) last month and she has run well in defeat since; stamina has to be taken on trust.

runners.comment: Modest form at up to 7f; dam a winner at the trip; still has time to do better
runners.name: Appetiser
runners.spotlight: Modest form in four runs at up to 7f, failing to improve for the switch to handicaps here last week; dam successful at this trip so some optimism for improvement.

runners.comment: Chance on best form for former stable; market useful after a 117-day break; AW debut
runners.name: Charming Fellow
runners.spotlight: In and out for Peter Chapple-Hyam and he ran poorly on heavy ground on final start for that yard in October; changed hands for 3,500gns soon after; market useful on stable/AW debut.

runners.comment: No better for handicapping at Newcastle last month; low mileage but needs headgear to work
runners.name: Hes Our Cracker
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the step up in trip/switch to handicaps when sixth of nine at Newcastle last month (1m2f); now tried in headgear; not fully exposed.

runners.comment: 0-11 and her last two starts have been disappointing; needs to raise her game
runners.name: Sands Of Havana
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; one encouraging effort for new yard in December but she hasn't built on it twice since (blinkered latest); needs more to come out on top.

runners.comment: 1m4f win here in November & went close over C&D last month; below par at Southwell latest
runners.name: Naughty Niall
runners.spotlight: 1m4f win here in November and narrowly denied by Scenario over C&D last month; needs to bounce back from a quiet run at Southwell but that's quite possible.

runners.comment: Beat Scenario here on Boxing Day; placed all three runs since; should be involved again
runners.name: Silkies Sib
runners.spotlight: Beat the reopposing Scenario by a nose over C&D on Boxing Day; three placed efforts have followed and likely to be in the thick of it again.

runners.comment: Well beaten in two runs for new trainer this year; down in weights but carries risk
runners.name: Lightningboltzoom
runners.spotlight: Good run on his handicap debut last January but struggled since, including both runs for new trainer this year; dropped 7lb for his troubles but not easily recommended.

runners.comment: Two good C&D runs around the turn of the year; not at the same level on last two runs
runners.name: Scenario
runners.spotlight: Two good C&D runs around the turn of the year; two latest efforts haven't been at that level though and she needs a full revival.

20:30.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Rider Restricted Race) (Div II)

runners.comment: C&D win on Boxing Day; beaten favourite but run okay over 1m twice since; should go well
runners.name: Galaxy Wonder
runners.spotlight: Made a promising stable debut at Kempton (7f) in December and built on it when dead-heating in a C&D handicap on Boxing Day; beaten favourite over 1m twice since but still more appealing than many now back up in trip.

runners.comment: Struggled for current yard but down in weights and the return of headgear could help
runners.name: Tiger Beetle
runners.spotlight: Shown little for new yard since returning from an absence in September; dropped a long way in the weights and the return of headgear could see him in a better light.

runners.comment: 7f win last month was followed by a poor run one week later; not ruled out
runners.name: Ana Emaraaty
runners.spotlight: Versatile 6yo who returned to winning ways over 7f at Newcastle last month; lacklustre effort 17 days ago but no surprise to see him rebound with a big run.

runners.comment: Two course wins; mixed bag this winter and others appeal more for win purposes
runners.name: Ciotog
runners.spotlight: Two course wins over 8.6f, the latest 13 months ago off an 11lb lower mark; ran okay over C&D last month but not so good at Lingfield last time; others preferred for win purposes.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 in good order; not at best last time but holds each-way claims in this field
runners.name: Revich
runners.spotlight: Veteran who ended 2025 with three solid efforts but not at his best here 46 days ago; dangerous mark and he holds each-way claims once more.

runners.comment: Improved when 4th over C&D on handicap debut in December; open to improvement; contender
runners.name: Wave Rock
runners.spotlight: She took a step forward when fourth of 12 over C&D on her handicap debut in December, form that has been boosted since; open to further progress and that doesn't apply to many of her rivals.

runners.comment: Promise in maiden/novice company but poor form since handicapping; headgear now added
runners.name: Read All About It
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has achieved little in three handicaps from 1m to 1m3f; dropped 10lb but cheekpieces need to make a huge difference.

runners.comment: Two heavy defeats for new yard last autumn; up in trip with headgear fitted
runners.name: Princess Jastar
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who returned after a lengthy absence with two heavy defeats for new yard last autumn; mark continues to fall but she has plenty to prove at this new trip after another break; eyeshields added.

runners.comment: 21-race maiden who ended 2025 quietly; others look stronger
runners.name: Ciara Storm
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden who ended 2025 quietly; others look stronger.
